result.document_summary: A mid-document fragment of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 2 Division 40, on Special Event Permits (§§ 22.4005-22.4018), captured from a code-publisher page whose URL refers to the algorithmic rent-pricing division.
result.notes: This part contains only special event permit provisions (exceptions, application content, conditions, denial, appeals, permit contents), which are outside the six rental-housing categories. The page URL points to San Diego's prohibition of algorithmic rent price-fixing (§ 98.1103), but the text in this part does not contain that provision, so no rule is extracted.
